findings.claim: Removing `getRelativeDistDir` drops root-relative dist-dir computation; any remaining call site in this file will fail to compile, and callers relying on root-relative ids change behavior.
findings.rationale: This hunk deletes the only definition of `getRelativeDistDir` but shows no corresponding removal of its usage. If the function is still referenced further down in `getCachedVitestImport` (or exported/used elsewhere), this is a TypeScript compile error. Even if the call site is removed in another hunk, the semantics it encoded are non-trivial and easy to lose: it normalized a trailing-slash root, special-cased root === '/', returned '' when `distDir` is not inside the root, and otherwise returned a path with a leading slash. Any replacement logic must reproduce all four behaviors, otherwise ids for Vitest dist files under a non-root-prefixed `distDir` (e.g. monorepo/pnpm layouts where vitest lives outside the project root) will resolve incorrectly. Confidence is moderate since I cannot see the rest of the file.

findings.claim: `normalizedDistDir` and `relativeIds` may now be dead or half-wired module state after the helper removal.
findings.rationale: `normalizedDistDir` was consumed by the deleted `getRelativeDistDir`, and `relativeIds` looks like the cache keyed by root that stored its results. If no other code in the file reads them, they are now unused module-level state (noUnusedLocals/lint failure, plus a cache written but never read). Conversely, if `relativeIds` is still read somewhere but its producer is gone, lookups will silently yield `undefined`, which would likely be concatenated into an id as the string "undefined". Worth verifying both are either removed or still genuinely used.
